## Notes

# Date palm notes

Onboarded through the species pipeline under fn-82, with fn-80 conducting its first live run. The run's stage records live under `.flow/evidence/date-palm/pipeline/`; this folder mirrors the canonical files the catalogue scripts read. The generator expresses the trunk (fn-108) and the apical rosette of pinnate fronds (fn-109); the retained leaf bases, the acanthophylls and the date cluster are fn-110 and fn-111 and the capability gate was waived for the first pass on the owner's word.
